title: 第23章 玄黄造化经第24章 突破极境
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 随着凌浩盘坐在洞府之中修炼的时间一点一滴的过去，凌浩开始吸收太古祖龙的精血，他本就是天生至尊，根基对于他来说是非常重要的，所以他想再利用太古祖龙的精血来强化根基
很快凌浩的身上散发着雾白色的光芒笼罩在凌浩的身上，体内源源不断的狂暴力量正在向凌浩的丹田处聚集
此时凌浩的头上可以不断的流出炽热的汗水，流出不到一秒钟就化为了水蒸气，随着凌浩体内的经脉不断的逆转，凌浩脸上露出了痛苦的神情，汗如雨滴
一股狂暴的力量在凌浩的体内疯狂的涌动，就好像随时都会冲破他全身的每一条经脉一般
“小青莲这是在干嘛呢？为什么整个精神识海开始暴躁起来了”
精神识海内的太古祖龙察觉到到凌浩的精神识海开始不断的躁动着道，于是移出精神识海看看究竟
“哇靠，你这是要干啥啊”
太古祖龙看着凌浩吸收自己的精血震惊的道，但却已经无法阻止了，因为凌浩已经马上就要将自己的精血融合了
“真是牲口啊，竟然生吞自己的精血，小小年纪就对这么狠”
太古祖龙看到最后也了解了凌浩的所作所为道，随后开始围绕着凌浩飞来飞去，仔细观察凌浩现在的状况，到时候也好指导一番
“嗯嗯，原来如此，天生极境，出世即是极境不愧是牲口”
太古祖龙这下是彻底明白了，凌浩乃是混沌青莲体更是天生极境，对于根基是非常看重的，只不过此时的凌浩吸收自己的精血恐怕会成为超越极境的变态
随后太古祖龙来到洞府外，吩咐着六十四帝卫着
“你们六十四帝卫派一些人去把整个秘境里的天材地宝都搜刮来，一会儿给你们的主子用”
太古祖龙看着洞府外的六十四帝卫道，如今凌浩吸收自己的精血需要大量的天材地宝来巩固自身的修为，储物戒里的修炼资源是肯定不够用的，如今凌浩需要的天材地宝更是极其庞大的数量，而如果加上秘境内的天材地宝应该足够吧
“明白了，我会派除了我和帝二的其余帝卫出去搜刮的”
帝一察觉到洞府内的动静后看着太古祖龙道
“除了帝二，你们去将洞府内的天材地宝都带回来”
“是，统领”
六十二帝卫恭敬的道，随后化做数道金光飞向秘境各各方向
太古祖龙看着帝卫都出去了，随后也返回到洞府内继续观察凌浩的动静，生怕他突然有什么意外，毕竟重塑根基可是重中之重啊
而此时的凌浩已经来到最后一根经脉了，脸上也更加痛苦，整个身上散发着炽热的温度，就像一座活火山，随时要爆发，整个身上都在冒着白烟
凌浩猛的睁开眼睛怒吼道，身上也随着一声顿时将整个山谷震的颤抖，山顶中的飞禽都被惊动的飞向天空
“呼.....呼......呼想不到吸收太古祖龙的精血这么痛苦”
凌浩用手撑着地不断的喘气着道，全身上下都还在痛的发抖，感觉随时都要倒下
“小青莲，吸收本祖的精血不好受吧哈哈”
太古祖龙飞到凌浩的身前笑着道，明知故问的问道，他可是知道自己的精血对于人族来说是至宝，但是吸收也要承受相应的痛苦
“哼，你知道还问”
凌浩白着眼看着太古祖龙道，现在的凌浩感觉自己的力量提升了不少，自身所掌握的力量更是比原来的多出太多了
现在自己一拳就可以打死上一秒的自己
“哈哈哈，我刚刚已经让帝卫出去帮你收割这个秘境里天材地宝了，一会儿你将修为巩固一下”
太古祖龙严肃的看着凌浩道
“你放心吧，你别看我还只是十岁，但是我懂的肯定比你多”
content_en:
As Ling Hao sat cross-legged in the cave and practiced, the time passed bit by bit. Ling Hao began to absorb the essence and blood of the ancient ancestral dragon. He was born supreme, and his foundation was very important to him, so he wanted to use the essence and blood of the ancient ancestral dragon to strengthen his foundation.
Soon Ling Hao's body was exuding a foggy white light that enveloped Ling Hao's body, and a steady stream of violent force in his body was gathering towards Ling Hao's Dantian.
At this time, Ling Hao's head could continuously flow out hot sweat, which turned into water vapor in less than a second. As the meridians in Ling Hao's body continued to reverse, Ling Hao's face showed a look of pain, and he sweated like raindrops.
A violent force surged crazily in Ling Hao's body, as if it would break through every meridian in his body at any time.
"What is Xiao Qinglian doing? Why is the entire sea of spiritual consciousness becoming irritable?"
The ancient ancestral dragon in the sea of spiritual consciousness noticed that Ling Hao's sea of spiritual consciousness began to stir, so he moved out of the sea of spiritual consciousness to see what happened.
"Wow, what are you doing?"
The Ancient Ancestral Dragon said in shock as he watched Ling Hao absorb his own essence and blood, but he could no longer stop it because Ling Hao was about to fuse his own essence and blood.
"What a beast. He actually swallowed his own essence and blood alive. He is so cruel at such a young age."
The Ancient Ancestral Dragon finally understood what Ling Hao was doing, and then began to fly around Ling Hao, carefully observing Ling Hao's current situation, so that he could give some guidance when the time comes.
"Yeah, that's it. I was born in the extreme state, and when I was born, I was in the extreme state. I am worthy of being an animal."
The Ancient Ancestral Dragon now completely understood that Ling Hao was born with a Chaos Green Lotus Body and was born in the extreme state. He valued his foundation very much. However, Ling Hao who absorbed his own essence and blood at this time might become a pervert beyond the extreme state.
Then the ancient ancestral dragon came outside the cave and ordered the sixty-four emperors to guard
"You sixty-fourth Emperor Guard sent some people to search for all the treasures in the secret realm and give them to your master later."
The Ancient Ancestral Dragon looked at the Sixty-Four Emperor Guards outside the cave. Now that Ling Hao has absorbed his own essence and blood, he needs a lot of heavenly materials and earthly treasures to consolidate his cultivation. The cultivation resources in the storage ring are definitely not enough. The amount of heavenly materials and earthly treasures that Ling Hao needs now is even more huge. If you add the heavenly materials and earthly treasures in the secret realm, it should be enough.
"Understood, I will send the rest of the Imperial Guard except me and Di Er to search."
Emperor Yi noticed the movement in the cave and looked at the ancient ancestor Long Dao.
"Except Emperor Er, you all go and bring back all the heavenly materials and earthly treasures in the cave."
"Yes, Commander"
The sixty-two imperial guards said respectfully, and then turned into several golden lights and flew in various directions in the secret realm.
The Ancient Ancestral Dragon watched the imperial guards go out, and then returned to the cave to continue to observe Ling Hao's movements, for fear that something might happen to him suddenly. After all, rebuilding the foundation is the most important thing.
At this time, Ling Hao has reached the last meridian, and his face is even more painful. His whole body is exuding a blazing temperature, like an active volcano, ready to erupt at any time, and his whole body is emitting white smoke.
Broken! ! !
Ling Hao opened his eyes fiercely and roared, his body also followed by a sound that shook the entire valley. The birds on the top of the mountain were frightened and flew into the sky.
"Huh... Huh... I can't imagine how painful it is to absorb the essence and blood of the ancient ancestral dragon."
Ling Hao held his hands on the ground and kept panting. His whole body was still shaking with pain, and he felt like he was going to fall down at any time.
"Xiao Qinglian, it's hard to absorb the essence and blood of my ancestor, haha"
The ancient ancestral dragon flew in front of Ling Hao and smiled, asking knowingly. He knew that his blood essence was a treasure to the human race, but he had to endure corresponding pain when absorbing it.
"Hmph, you know and you still ask."
Ling Hao looked at the ancient ancestor Long Dao with white eyes. Now Ling Hao feels that his strength has improved a lot, and the power he has mastered is much more than before.
Now I can kill myself a second ago with just one punch.
"Hahaha, I just asked the imperial guards to go out to help you harvest the treasures of heaven and earth in this secret realm. You will consolidate your cultivation in a while."
The ancient ancestral dragon looked at Ling Hao seriously and said
"Don't worry, even though I'm only ten years old, I definitely know more than you."
